articles.description: Tarrannum Naik, a 23-year-old engineering student, was found dead in a valley near Naikwadi waterfall. Her boyfriend, Sripad Vadar, was arrested after police discovered inconsistencies in his statements. He initially claimed Tarrannum fell into the valley, but chat history indicated he was upset about her arranged marriage. The police are awaiting a postmortem report to determine the cause of her death.

Michigan couple loses claim to 50-foot land strip after neighbour commissions two surveys
articles.description: A Michigan couple has lost a legal battle over a 50-foot-wide strip of land they claimed was wrongly excluded from their property because of an error in a 1965 deed. The couple, who bought their land at a 2015 tax sale, argued that previous owners had used the disputed area for decades. However, two surveys placed the land within their neighbour's property. On October 9, 2026, the Michigan Court of Appeals ruled against the couple, citing insufficient evidence to establish ownership.

articles.title: Tyler Perry donated $750K to clear property tax debt for 300+ Atlanta seniors
articles.description: Tyler Perry has made a significant donation of $750,000 to assist low-income senior citizens in Atlanta. This contribution will help more than 300 seniors pay overdue property taxes and remain in their homes. Additionally, it will support a pilot program for another 100 seniors facing property tax increases. Mayor Dickens emphasized the importance of preserving the homes of longstanding residents amid Atlanta's growth.

articles.title: University of Glasgow develops £20 ultrasound device to produce fertiliser from air and water
articles.description: Researchers at the University of Glasgow have developed an affordable ultrasound device to produce nitrate for agriculture. This device uses sound waves, air, and water to create nitrate without industrial production reliance. While current experiments show potential, energy consumption remains high compared to the Haber-Bosch process. The team plans to refine the design over the next year for practical agricultural use.

articles.title: Stock market today: Sensex rebounds after 300-point jump; Nifty holds above 22,550
articles.full_text: The rupee rebounded sharply from a record low level, gaining 91 paise to 95.80 against the US dollar in early trade on Monday, after the Reserve Bank of India stepped in with several measures to contain volatility in the currency exchange market. Indian shares are set to open higher on Monday after ending their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years on Friday, supported by a decline in oil prices amid hopes of a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire and fresh currency-support measures announced by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). GIFT Nifty futures stood at 22,624.5 at 7:53 am IST, signalling a positive start for the Nifty 50, which closed at 22,520.45 on Friday. Stock market is crashing, but IPOs are seeing billions of dollars of investment. What’s happening? Global stock markets opened on a mixed note on Monday as investors braced for the earnings season. South Korea’s benchmark index fell 2.2%, while Taiwan’s shares slipped 0.5%. MSCI’s broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares excluding Japan declined 0.3%, while China’s blue-chip index edged up 0.1%. In the US, S&P 500 futures rose 0.3% and Nasdaq futures gained 0.4%. European markets also pointed to a positive start, with EURO STOXX 50 futures up 0.5%, Germany’s DAX futures gaining 0.6% and FTSE futures rising 0.4%. Oil prices fell on Monday on expectations of increased Russian supplies after US President Donald Trump said Ukraine and Russia had agreed to halt attacks on each other’s energy facilities, following a US deal with Moscow to supply diesel. Brent crude futures fell $1.54, or 1.47%, to $103.18 a barrel by 0154 GMT. US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude declined by $1.54, or 1.68%, to $90.31 a barrel. The BSE Sensex surged 879.09 points, or 1.23%, to close at 72,472.33 on Friday. The index had settled at 71,593.24 in the previous session. It opened at 71,776.67 and touched an intraday high of 72,669.20 and a low of 71,739.49.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Abhay Jodhpurkar recalls SRK supporting his voice for Zero's Mere Naam Tu
articles.description: Abhay Jodhpurkar opens up to Variety India about industry gatekeeping, self-doubt and how Ajay-Atul backed his voice for Shah Rukh Khan’s ‘Mere Naam Tu’ from ‘Zero’. The singer recalls A.R. Rahman trying to launch him in several projects, only for recordings to be replaced by established voices. He also criticises commercial decision-making in playback singing after winning a National Award for ‘Navasachi Gauri Mazi’ from ‘Gharat Ganpati’, a song rooted in his cultural upbringing.

articles.title: Mirnaa Menon recalls health scare during 'Jailer 2' shoot
articles.description: On the set of 'Jailer 2', Mirnaa Menon battled considerable health challenges just hours before a pivotal scene. Demonstrating remarkable resolve, she pursued medical attention and, after an arduous search, received treatment that allowed her to participate in the shoot. Despite her initial doubts about her acting due to her physical condition, the director's confidence in her abilities shone through, and she felt pleased with the final product during dubbing.
